mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (historical 2008-2010 data).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.25 percentage points signals monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a strengthening labor market, driving consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1800 thousand signal a housing market recovery, boosting consumer confidence and retail sales, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1800.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 115 indicates a manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 115.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) dropping below 340000 million signals weak consumer demand, leading to lower corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 340000.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE falls) signals improving labor conditions, boosting consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls in high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, stabilizing the economy and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS falls and CPIAUCSL rises.
